command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps='CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'; foreach(`$p in `$ps){ `$c1=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/Core_SW_01/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$c2=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/Core_SW_02/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$p2=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/PE2/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$p3=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/PE3/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; Write-Output (`$p+' Core1_STP='+(`$c1 -match '(?m)^stp enable$')+' Core2_STP='+(`$c2 -match '(?m)^stp enable$')+' PE2_long_cost='+(`$p2 -match '(?m)^ isis cost ')+' PE3_long_cost='+(`$p3 -match '(?m)^ isis cost '))}"
